Html: Ok, after having advanced to section 7 of the tutorial, I understand why this doesn't work. However, the error message could be improved to eg "Access to private members is not allowed in precondition of public method. Use a public getter method instead." Users may be tempted to just change the protection level from private to public.

Just include

using Microsoft.Contracts;

at the start of your file.

Then prepend your int declaration like this:

[SpecPublic]int a;

I think this basically makes your variable publically visibile to the specification tools while not altering its actual privacy level in C#.

There's one or two other issues in your code though.
